title: Page 77
transc:
Ft Monroe April 21 1864
SH Beckwith  Culpepper CH
for Jupiter unity the following from a letter of Shelby
vessels at Plymouth on the gift instant is forwarded for
your Sweden violet Hotels opal is in motion for garden
pedlar Haddock & many officers passed up to Galway last
week & talked freely torch opening Campaign pekin it is
Hunters intention to anticipate Junos combination take initiative Yoke Knox
Geo D Sheldon


Washington April 21 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Rosetta for Knots unity if you can block
the channel Baden Sidney so she can not
get in to pamlico Sound we will have
some camels make in a few days to
lighten the Tecumseh iron cleared so she can
cross the bare at Hatter as platina feet
& protect all waxy of Baden Smyrna Yoke
ass Buxton Fawks how fie you brave youths
Thos T Eckert
